text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends prohibiting standing at all times on the west side of Chancery Lane, between Guildwood Parkway and Cadbury Court. Currently, parking is prohibited from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on both sides of this street.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on both sides of Chancery Lane, between Guildwood Parkway and Toynbee Trail. 2. Prohibited parking from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Chancery Lane, between Guildwood Parkway and Cadbury Court. 3. Prohibited standing from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Chancery Lane, between Guildwood Parkway and Cadbury Court.
